plot: On Polly's birthday Grandma takes her for a walk and Max has fifteen minutes to secretly wrap a round blue teacup, but the paper springs off the round cup and the tape sticks to his paw, whiskers and Dog's nose; Max puts the cup in Dog's empty cookie box, but tapes his own tail to it, Dog pulls him free and the paper rips, so the present ends up a crumpled tape ball he hides behind the sofa, until Pickles finds it and rips it happily and Polly says neat presents are over in a second for Pickles but this one is his favorite kind, the box kept the cup safe, and next morning in the park Dog's tail is green.

beats.say: Get off! Get OFF my paw, sticky tape!
Max! Now the tape is stuck on MY nose!
Ten minutes earlier, on Polly's birthday morning.
Happy birthday, Polly! Let's take a little walk in the park.
Grandma winks at Max and points to the kitchen table.
Paper with yellow stars. Sticky tape. Red ribbon. And a teacup.
A round blue teacup, with a little bird painted on it.
Max, you wrap Polly's present while we're out. Secret mission!
Easy! I'm a cat. Cats are amazing with paper.
Pickles hops over and tears a corner off the paper. Rrrip!
Not yet, Pickles! You have to wait for the party!
Wait for the party! Squawk! Wait for the party!
Polly, Grandma and Pickles go out of the door.
We'll be back in fifteen minutes, dears!
I'll watch the street from the window. I'm the lookout!
And I'll hold the corners. Paper is sneaky.
Step one. Max cuts the paper with his claws.
Snip, snip, zig, zag. The paper looks like a lightning bolt.
That's... a fancy shape. Very modern.
Step two. Max wraps the paper around the round teacup.
He lets go. Boing! The paper jumps right off again.
Round things don't like paper, Max. Paper likes flat things.
Then I'll use more tape. LOTS of tape!
Rrrrip! The tape sticks to his paw. He shakes it off.
Now it's on his whiskers. He shakes again.
And the tape flies right onto Dog's nose.
Hey! My nose can't smell anything! Is this a game?
No! It's a disaster! The cup isn't wrapped at all!
Max! I can see them at the park gate!
They're turning around! Only ten minutes left!
Ten minutes? Polly will see a teacup in a paper mess!
Max looks around the room for an idea. Fast.
Next to the sofa is Dog's empty cookie box.
A box! A box is square! Square things love paper!
That's my cookie box. But it's empty. I checked. Twice.
Max puts the teacup in the box. It fits just right.
Mouse holds the corners. Max folds the paper. It stays!
It's working! Now one strip of tape... and one more...
And one more. And one more. And one more.
Max? Where is your tail?
Max's tail is taped to the box. So are his paws.
Help! I wrapped myself into the present!
Don't worry! I'll pull you out. One, two, three!
Dog pulls. Max pops free. And the paper rips in half. Rrrrip!
They're at the garden gate! They're coming in!
No time for new paper! What do we do?
Max quickly sticks the torn paper back on. Tape, tape, tape.
Now the present looks like a crumpled, crunchy paper ball.
It's the worst present in the whole world.
I can't give her this. I'll hide it behind the sofa.
The door opens. Polly, Grandma and Pickles come in.
What a lovely walk! Oh, I smell sticky tape!
Pickles stops. He sniffs. Then he flies straight behind the sofa.
No, Pickles! Not that one! It's a mess!
Paper! Paper! Party! Squawk!
Pickles rips the paper. Rrrip! He tosses it high. Rrrip!
He rips, and rips, and rips, and he doesn't stop.
Oh no. He's ruining it even more.
But Polly claps her hands and laughs.
Look at him! I've never seen Pickles so happy!
Every birthday, Pickles opens my presents for me.
Neat ones are over in one second. Rip, done!
But this one? This one he can rip all morning!
So my messy wrapping is... his favorite kind?
Favorite kind! Favorite kind! Rrrip!
Under all the paper, there's the box. And inside, the teacup.
And look, not one crack! The box kept it safe.
A teacup with a little bird on it! Thank you, Max!
Pickles throws the paper bits up high, like birthday snow.
Paper snow! And my nose can smell again! Cookies!
Best wrapping ever. Two presents in one!
A present doesn't need to be perfect. Just from your heart.
The next morning, in the park, Max looks at his friend.
Dog? Why is your tail... GREEN?

long.title: Can Max Wrap a Gift With Sticky Paws? 🎁
long.description:
"I'm a cat. Cats are amazing with paper. I think." 🐱
It's Polly's birthday and Max has a secret mission: wrap her present before everyone gets back from the walk. But the sticky tape has other plans. Max the Curious Cat, Ep 40.
